currentParagraphText: “I have one gamble, but I have no idea if it will work, and it may end up just dooming us all here and now,” Jake said to the others in the room.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “I have one gamble, but I have no idea if it will work, and it may end up just dooming us all here and now,” Jake said to the others in the room.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Then at least this brief third chance at life would have ended at my own choice,” the Forest King said.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: At some point, as long as Jake and the others were alive, the masked gods would be tracked down. Leaving them alive for too long was thus simply too risky an option. As Jake looked around the room, they all seemed to also realize this as Jake spoke.
